1. Agriculture Fundamentals

PURPOSE
farm system, crop production cycle, inputs and outputs. This page is part of the
100-page and contains practical crop, risk, precaution and
technology information.

CORE EXPLANATION
Agriculture Fundamentals: farm system, crop production cycle, inputs and outputs.
Connect the topic to crop, season, growth stage, soil, water, weather,
pest/disease pressure and farm economics.

SEASON + WEATHER
Kharif is broadly monsoon-linked, Rabi is broadly winter-linked and Zaid is
generally the summer/inter-season period. Exact dates vary by district. Record
rainfall, temperature, humidity and wind because these affect crop growth,
irrigation and disease/pest risk.

PRECAUTIONS
Use healthy planting material, suitable varieties, appropriate planting time,
sanitation, balanced nutrition, weed control, appropriate irrigation and drainage,
rotation where suitable and regular scouting. For chemical products, verify the
current official label and local recommendation.

MODERN FARMING CONNECTION
Drip irrigation, fertigation, soil sensors, automated irrigation, weather
stations, IoT, drones, satellite imagery, GIS/GPS, precision seeding,
variable-rate technology, AI/ML, protected cultivation, hydroponics and robotics
can improve farming when correctly designed and maintained.
